items.informal_name: Linear combination of vectors indexed by α over R
items.type:
{α : Type u_1} →
  {M : Type u_2} →
    (R : Type u_5) →
      [inst : Semiring R] → [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] → [inst_2 : Module R M] → (α → M) → (α →₀ R) →ₗ[R] M
items.informal_description: The linear map from the space of finite support functions $ \alpha \to_0 R $ to the module $ M $, which sends each finite support function $ d $ to the sum $ \sum_{i \in \text{support } d} d(i) \cdot v_i $, where $ v_i $ denotes the vector associated with index $ i $. This map is constructed using the linear equivalence of summing scalar multiples of individual vectors embedded via the right scalar multiplication operation.

items.informal_description: The additive homomorphism from the space of finite support functions $ \sigma \to_0 R $ to the module $ M $, which maps each finite support function $ d $ to the sum $ \sum_{i \in \text{support } d} d(i) \cdot v_i $, where $ v_i $ denotes the vector associated with index $ i $.

items.informal_name: Weighted Sum Evaluation: $ \text{weight } w f = \sum_{i \in \text{support } f} c_i \cdot w(i) $
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → M) [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M] (f : σ →₀ R), (Finsupp.weight w) f = f.sum fun i c => c • w i
items.informal_description: For any finite support function $ f : \sigma \to_0 R $, the weight function applied to $ f $ is equal to the sum over all $ i $ in the support of $ f $ of $ c \cdot w(i) $, where $ c $ is the coefficient of $ i $ in $ f $ and $ w : \sigma \to M $ is a function assigning vectors to indices.

items.informal_name: Linear Map Induced by Function Between Finite Sets Acts by Summing Over Preimages
items.informal_description: For finite sets $X$ and $Y$, a function $f : X \to Y$, and a function $s : X \to M$ where $M$ is an $R$-module, the evaluation of the linear map induced by $f$ at $s$ and $y \in Y$ equals the sum of $s(x)$ for all $x \in X$ satisfying $f(x) = y$. Formally, $(\mathrm{linearMap}\, f\, s)(y) = \sum_{x \in f^{-1}(y)} s(x)$.

items.informal_name: Linear Map Application as Basis Vector Sum
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {M₂ : Type w} {ι : Type x} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M₂] [inst_2 : Module R M₂]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_4 : Fintype ι] (f : (ι → R) →ₗ[R] M₂) (x : ι → R),
  f x = ∑ i, x i • f fun j => if i = j then 1 else 0
items.informal_description: For any finite index set $\iota$, a linear map $f : (\iota \to R) \to M_2$ between an $R$-module product space and another $R$-module $M_2$, and for any element $x : \iota \to R$, the evaluation $f(x)$ equals the finite sum $\sum_{i \in \iota} x_i \cdot f(e_i)$, where $e_i$ denotes the basis vector in $\iota \to R$ with $1$ at index $i$ and $0$ elsewhere.

items.informal_name: Linear Combination Compatibility with Domain Comap under Injectivity
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} (R : Type u_5) [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  {α' : Type u_7} {v : α → M} (f : α → α') (l : α' →₀ R) (hf : Set.InjOn f (f ⁻¹' ↑l.support)),
  (Finsupp.linearCombination R v) (Finsupp.comapDomain f l hf) = ∑ i ∈ l.support.preimage f hf, l (f i) • v i
items.informal_description: For an injective function $ f : \alpha \to \alpha' $ on the preimage of the support of a finite support function $ l : \alpha' \to_0 R $, the linear combination of the comapped function $ \text{comapDomain } f \, l $ equals the sum over $ i \in f^{-1}(\text{support } l) $ of $ l(f(i)) \cdot v_i $. Formally, $ \text{linearCombination } R \, v (\text{comapDomain } f \, l) = \sum_{i \in f^{-1}(\text{support } l)} l(f(i)) \cdot v_i $.

items.informal_name: Linear Combination over Finite Set Equals Sum
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} (R : Type u_5) [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  {s : Finset α} {f : α → R} (g : α → M) (hf : ∀ (a : α), f a ≠ 0 → a ∈ s),
  (Finsupp.linearCombination R g) (Finsupp.onFinset s f hf) = ∑ x ∈ s, f x • g x
items.informal_description: For any finite set $s$ of indices, scalar function $f : \alpha \to R$, and vector function $g : \alpha \to M$, if $f$ is non-zero only on $s$, then the linear combination of $g$ using the finite support function derived from $f$ equals the sum over $s$ of $f(x) \cdot g(x)$. Formally, $\text{linearCombination}_R(g)(\text{onFinset}(s,f)) = \sum_{x \in s} f(x) \cdot g(x)$.

items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_4} {M : Type u_5} {ι : Type u_6} [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_2 : Module R M] (i : ι)
  (c : ι → R) (h₀ : c i = 0) (v : ι → M),
  Finsupp.linearCombination R v ∘ₗ ↑(Finsupp.addSingleEquiv i c h₀) =
    Finsupp.linearCombination R (v + fun x => c x • v i)
items.informal_description: Composing the linear combination map with the addSingleEquiv at index $i$ and scalar $c$ results in the linear combination of the function obtained by adding $c$ times the vector at index $i$ to the original function $v$. Formally, $\text{linearCombination}_R(v + c \cdot v_i) = \text{linearCombination}_R(v) \circ \text{addSingleEquiv}(i, c)$.
